title: Hardly any fragrance, short burn time, didn't like
text: Hardly any fragrance, short burn time, didn't like. I was very disappointed with this candle. First, I burn candles all the time in my home (even leave a small tea light scented on in my bathroom when I am home for hours each day. When I saw this candle, I was really interested to try it as I have used Via Mercato items before (I love their liquid soaps) and I really like them. I won't go into too much detail here because many others have expressed the concerns I have. First, it's the amount of time you can burn this (one hour) is totally ridiculous. Second, I also don't like the way this burns (down the center). And last, but more importantly is the fragrance, there is barely any to discern (I had the Peach and Fig variety). Very disappointed and won't be buying again.
